labels.note: semantically related schedule facts; only the first-bus time is probed

turns.text: You dispatch buses at Corbie terminus. Log the departures for the Larkhill route: the first bus leaves at 10 minutes past the hour; the express leaves at 25 minutes to the hour; the night service runs only at midnight. Confirm in one line.
A passenger asks, and there is no timetable in front of you: at how many minutes past the hour does the first Larkhill bus leave? Reply with just the number.
